Widmer"><organization/></author> <date year="2008" month="September"/> <abstract><t>This document specifies TCP Friendly Rate Control (TFRC). TFRC is a congestion control mechanism for unicast flows operating in a best-effort Internet environment. It is reasonably fair when competing for bandwidth with TCP flows, but has a much lower variation of throughput over time compared with TCP, making it more suitable for applications such as streaming media where a relatively smooth sending rate is of importance.</t><t>This document obsoletes RFC 3448 and updates RFC 4342. [STANDARDS-TRACK]</t></abstract> </front> <seriesInfo name="RFC" value="5348"/> <seriesInfo name="DOI" value="10.17487/RFC5348"/> </reference>
